title: consolidate API-like interfaces
symptom: The issue describes that xDrip has several API-like interfaces (SendXdripBroadcast, NSClientReceiver, ExternalStatusBroadcastReceiver, XdripWebService) that are chaotic and could be consolidated into one intent broadcast service. It also notes that some endpoints only semi work, e.g., /tasker/snooze works but /tasker/restart collector does not.
evidence_quote: Endpoints that have been in place for a while only semi work. E.g. this works. http://127.0.0.1:17580/tasker/snooze But this doesn't http://127.0.0.1:17580/tasker/restart%20collector
